messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGING: High 5xx rate on Dedicated eu-west-1 - flagged by KPI alert (errors > 15% for 5m). Affected tenant: MacroGrid (enterprise). Paging oncall: @Rod. runbook: /runbooks/dedicated-eu-routing.md
Rod (oncall): on it. pulling logs now. ETA ~5.
Maria (SRE): I see spike in proxy 502s out of the routing tier, looks like backend pool 'dedicated-eu-4' returning OOM errors. stack traces pointing to model-worker process.
Rod (oncall): @Maria can you confirm if this is autoscale related? was capacity recently changed?
Maria (SRE): Checking cluster events... `kubectl get hpa -n redwood-dedicated-eu` shows no scale events in last 15m. However node memory pressure detected at 13:42 UTC.
Tim (Engineer): Deploy bot shows a config push 13:35 from CI: `runtime-config: kv-cache=false` — not sure if related but worth flagging.
Aaron (Ops): We had a batch job (customer data migration) running on those GPUs earlier today, might've left some pinned pages. I can repro the OOM locally.
Rod (oncall): Triage plan: 1) divert MacroGrid traffic to fallback pool (dedicated-eu-2) 2) scale up dedicated-eu-4 nodes 3) restart model-worker on affected pods 4) post status update to status.redwood.ai 5) notify AE + support with targeted customer note.
Jess (AE): I'll prepare customer-facing impact text once we have scope. MacroGrid contacts: eng-ops@macrogrid.com, s-rep@macrogrid.com, exec@macrogrid.com. Priority: high — they're running live inference pipelines.
Kyle (Support Lead): Queue created: INC-20912. I'll cold-call MacroGrid primary and escalate to their on-call if no answer. Template for customer note?
Rod (oncall): Draft for status page: "We are investigating elevated error rates for Dedicated eu-west-1 affecting MacroGrid. Engineers are rerouting traffic and scaling capacity. No data loss expected. Next update in 15 minutes." Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Maria (SRE): add: "Affected endpoints: /v1/hosted/* (macrogrid-tenant)" and mention possible latency increase during mitigation.
Rod (oncall): updated draft appended below.
Rod (oncall): ```Status update (external): 2026-03-15 13:50 UTC - We are investigating elevated 5xx error rates for Dedicated eu-west-1 impacting MacroGrid's tenant. Engineers have initiated traffic rerouting to a fallback pool and started capacity scale-up. Request processing may experience retries or latency increases. We will provide a further update within 15 minutes.```
Jess (AE): That's good. Add PSA for customers: "If you see persistent failures, please contact support and include request_id header."
Tim (Engineer): I'm running `kubectl rollout restart statefulset/model-worker -n redwood-dedicated-eu --selector=pool=dedicated-eu-4` on two affected AZs now. Watching Pod logs: `tail -f /var/log/model-worker.log` shows repeated `CUDA out of memory` within 30s of allocation.
Maria (SRE): Rolling restart completed for 4/8 pods. Error rate dropped to 8% in the metric dashboard. CPU stable, memory still trending high on the remaining pods.
Aaron (Ops): I temporarily increased node pool instance count +1 (g4dn.xlarge -> +1) to relieve memory pressure. Autoscaling task queued.
Rod (oncall): Good. Re-route step: switching routing policy to `fallback-pool` for MacroGrid, engineer Tim is executing.
Tim (Engineer): Routing change applied via `redwoodctl route set --tenant macrogrid --pool dedicated-eu-2 --sticky false`. Confirmed new requests landing on fallback. Error rate for MacroGrid now ~2% (per-tenant metric). :white_check_mark:
IncidentBot: Incident status changed: PARTIAL_MITIGATION — routing fallback applied.
Rod (oncall): Okay team — prepare customer notification. @Jess please send this template to MacroGrid (edit as needed):
Rod (oncall): ```Hi MacroGrid team,

We detected elevated error rates affecting your Dedicated eu-west-1 allocation. Engineers mitigated by rerouting your traffic to an alternate pool and scaling capacity; the majority of requests are now processing normally. There may be transient retries or elevated latency for a short window. No customer data was exposed. Our action items: ongoing capacity scaling and a postmortem scheduled. We'll follow up with timeline and RCA.

If you continue to see errors, please reply to this thread or call your support number.

— Redwood Inference Ops
```
Jess (AE): Sending now to eng-ops@macrogrid.com and cc: exec@macrogrid.com. I'll paste status page link too once posted.
Kyle (Support Lead): MacroGrid acknowledged receipt and is monitoring. They reported a small backlog of queued inference requests, no data loss. :thumbsup:
Rod (oncall): Next steps for internal comms: create short internal post for #customer-impact with account list, routing changes, and expected ETA to full restore. Draft below.
Rod (oncall): ```Internal note (for #customer-impact): Impact: MacroGrid (Dedicated eu-west-1) experienced elevated 5xx errors due to memory pressure on model-worker pool. Mitigation: traffic routed to dedicated-eu-2, node pool +1, rolling restarts performed. Current state: traffic routing applied, error rate back to baseline (~<3%), scaling in progress. ETA to full validation: 45-60 minutes. Contacts: Jess (AE), Kyle (Support).```
Maria (SRE): Add to the incident timeline that we saw a config change disabling KV caching earlier — investigating whether that increased memory usage per request.
Tim (Engineer): I snapshot logs and saved `/artifacts/incidents/2081234567/model-worker-oom.tar.gz`. Uploading to incident ticket.
Aaron (Ops): Will coordinate with infra to check for left-over batch jobs that could be using GPU memory; running `ps aux | grep migrate` on nodes.
Rod (oncall): Handoff note for next oncall: Please continue monitoring per-tenant error rate and confirm autoscaler scaled nodes to target. If errors spike above 10% re-run restart sequence and open escalation to SRE lead.
Jess (AE): MacroGrid wants a short formal status for execs by EOD. I'll draft a concise impact statement once we have RCA details.
Rod (oncall): Logging final: current severity: WARNING -> PARTIAL_MITIGATION. Will send status page update: "Mitigation applied, monitoring" in 10m if stable. Team, great coordination. :pray:
Kyle (Support Lead): Closing loop with support rotation: I'm adding notes to INC-20912 and pinging oncall follow-up in 45m.
Tim (Engineer): Last check - response times improving, p50 restored. Keeping watch on memory metrics.
Maria (SRE): I'll own the RCA. Initial hypothesis: config change + residual batch job = increased memory footprint leading to OOMs.
Rod (oncall): End of thread for handoff. Next update posted at 2026-03-15 14:45 UTC if any changes. :white_check_mark:
